speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN).

The presence of fever, flank pain, elevated creatinine, and leukocyturia combined with the specific finding of 3% binucleated eosinophils on the urinary cytospin is highly suggestive of drug-induced acute interstitial nephritis, likely triggered by your recent antibiotic treatment.
